normalization: The Hades binary path, synthetic HOME/HERMES_HOME, PTY path, session identifiers, timestamps, and dynamic redraw bytes are omitted or represented by placeholders.
Each fresh process removes HADES and OpenAI provider environment variables, submits /help, waits for Setup Required, and probes one safe follow-up command or the Ctrl+C control case.
The replay inspects the latest normalized screen frame for draft clearing, while the report retains only stable overlay, picker/wizard, provider, config, liveness, and terminal-restoration outcomes.
The Hermes ready-marker redraw is not treated as a Hades requirement; no actionable /model or /setup route is inferred from the explanatory overlay strings.
